# file-uploader
> Storage-agnostic upload pipeline: pluggable StorageDriver (local disk + in-memory bundled), magic-byte MIME validation, sanitized filenames, and content-hash dedup. Zero runtime dependencies.

A storage-agnostic upload pipeline: you give it a `Buffer` and a filename, it validates the content, dedups by hash if you want, generates a safe unique filename, and stores it via a pluggable driver.

## API
- `LocalDiskDriver`
- `InMemoryDriver`
- `sniffMimeType`
- `MIME_BY_TYPE`
- `validateFile`
- `sanitizeFilename`
- `uniqueFilename`
- `sha256`
- `UploadPipeline`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/FerrowAI.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
